thin.what is missing: Month and source for the Japanese evacuation of Hanseong in 1593 (confidence 1; the Imjin War page is cut at July 1592 and gives no date).
Month and source for the Japanese loss of Pyongyang in 1593 (confidence 1); warring-states-japan dates the withdrawal to January 1593 from the Azuchi-Momoyama page.
The second invasion of 1597 (Jeongyu war): the Japanese advance into Jeolla and Chungcheong (Namwon, Jeonju) in autumn 1597 and its end are not in the ledger; only the coast held 1592-1598 is.

First Sino-Japanese War: the war note cites a Japanese occupation dated 23 July 1894 but the ledger has no occupation_start/occupation_end with empire-of-japan (Gyeongbokgung and Seoul from July 1894) and the zones are empty although the war was 'fought largely in Korea' (Seonghwan, Pyongyang 1894).

Rebels that held Joseon land are absent: Yi Gwal's rebellion (1624, Hanseong briefly taken), Hong Gyeong-nae's rebellion (1811-1812, Pyongan towns), the Donghak Peasant Revolution (1894, Jeonju taken). Each could be a rebel contest or occupation event if a page dates the held ground.
